persona_assignment_rationale: The persona is a 22-year-old white female living in urban New York, working in retail, highly progressive, and a regular news consumer. Variables selected include race (white), sex (female), residence in a large city (New York), political views (liberal to represent highly progressive), frequency of political news consumption (several times a day), work status (working full time), occupation sector (retail trade), and survey year (2024). Age is not directly available as a variable, so it is omitted.
